name: textoverlay-videomasking

frames.best_why: The lettering is widest and the green-blue footage inside it is at its brightest, with no cursor over the text.

tagline: A looping video plays only inside big italic letters on black.
summary: One line of oversized bold italic text works as a cut-out window, so a nature clip moves inside the letterforms while everything around them stays near-black.
appearance: A wide near-black panel holds a single line of large, heavy italic lettering with an underline stroke. The strokes are not a solid colour: they are filled with blue and green foliage footage, so the word shimmers while the surrounding panel is flat black.
behaviour: The clip inside the letters plays on a loop from the moment the panel loads, brightening and shifting as the camera moves over greenery. Nothing reacts to the pointer; the panel itself never changes shape or size.
search_phrases: video playing through cut out letters
big text filled with moving footage
landing page title with video fill
letters as windows onto a film
use_when: A hero or section title should carry motion and atmosphere without a full video block behind it.
avoid_when: The video is a remote full-resolution file that streams on a loop, so a slow link leaves the letters black.
customise: The word and the video address are written into the file and there are no props, so swapping the copy or the clip means editing the source.
weight_why: A full-resolution remote video decodes and loops the whole time it is on screen.

a11y.note: The looping video ignores reduced-motion preferences, and nothing labels the clip for screen readers.

issues: The word sits left of centre with a large empty black area to its right.
polish_why: Masked type reads cleanly with good footage fill; the off-centre placement leaves dead space.
title: Text Overlay Video Mask
